messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'velox-dedicated-pool' node 'node-37' entering thermal throttle state; GPU clocks dropping and several pods evicted. Observed increased 5xxs for tenant velox-prod. See runbook: /runbooks/dedpool-thermal.
ashwin: Paging SRE on-call, I'm shadowing for this one. I see the alert, joining now.
maria: Infra oncall here — what's the impact surface? which tenant?
ashwin: account-eng-velox flagged it — velox-prod is hitting ~3-4x latency and ~10% error rate. Node id node-37 in us-east-1a.
account-eng-velox: Velox support — confirmed high latencies and failed inferences. Can you isolate the node and migrate traffic? Customer impacted: production inference for a few critical customers.
sre-lead: Triage plan (short): 1) cordon node-37, 2) drain/evict workloads, 3) if eviction stalls, spin up standby in same AZ and migrate traffic, 4) engage ops-hardware for RMA. Assign: Maria do cordon+drain, Ashwin monitor traffic and communicate with account.
maria: Cording now: `rosterctl cordon node-37 --pool=velox-dedicated-pool` -> SUCCESS. Beginning drain/evict.
ashwin: Running eviction: `rosterctl evict node-37 --force --exclude=system` — pushing evictions.
ops-hardware: HW notes: fan at 100%, VRAM sensor intermittently reporting >90C spikes. Looks like fan or heatsink issue. Will open RMA. ETA for field swap ~3h. Any soft mitigation we can try to stop further evictions?
sre-lead: Try powercap to reduce thermal pressure and avoid hard evict cascades: set GPU powerlimit to 250W and enable persistence mode. Maria, can you apply and monitor?
maria: Applied: `nvidia-smi -pm 1 && nvidia-smi -pl 250`. Watching metrics now.
incident-bot: Autoscaler note: a standby node 'velox-standby-2' launched in us-east-1a and is joining pool to accept redirected traffic.
ashwin: Migration in progress, routing rules updating. Any cross-tenant impact?
account-eng-velox: Only velox-prod seeing issues. We'll throttle non-critical QPS to reduce load during migration. Customers are being notified.
cust-success-velox: Messaging sent to Velox ops: "We're isolating a GPU node causing degraded performance; mitigation underway; expected resolution within ~3 hours. We'll follow up with a postmortem."
maria: Drain progress: 95% complete. Two sessions stuck and not terminating: pids 1123, 1187. Attempting graceful shutdown with 60s grace.
ashwin: If they don't drop, kill after grace. Check for any stateful checkpoints before kill.
account-eng-velox: Both are batch jobs — checkpointed to S3, safe to restart.
maria: Killed stuck pids after grace, evictions complete, node remains cordoned. Traffic shifted to standby. Velox PROD latency returning to baseline.
incident-bot: Incident updated -> severity downgraded to SEV-3. Scheduling postmortem.
ops-hardware: RMA ticket created TKT-88922. Field tech ETA 2.5h. Posting recent sensor log snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T04:12:02Z] fan_pwm=100 temp_gfx=86 temp_vram=93 throttle=1
[2026-03-15T04:12:05Z] ecc_errors=0 pcie_aer=0 nvlink_err=0
```
ashwin: Suggest quarantine policy: mark node-37 as quarantined until physical swap and burn-in. After RMA, run extended perf test (30m) under 90% synthetic load.
sre-lead: Agreed. Add verification checklist: 1) hardware swap, 2) firmware & driver parity check, 3) 30m stress test, 4) reincorporate only after zero throttling.
account-eng-velox: We'll arrange a customer-facing follow-up call at 10:00 PT to review impact and timeline. Please add any mitigation notes to the incident doc.
cust-success-velox: Confirmed customer update and internal CS briefing done.
maria: Handoff to night oncall: tagging @lee.ash.
oncall-pager: @lee.ash now oncall — acknowledged. I'll keep an eye on alerts/metrics overnight. If throttling reappears, escalate to SEV-2.
ashwin: Documenting timeline in incident tracker: https://redwood.incidents/2425001234 (placeholder). Commands used, metrics, and logs attached.
sre-lead: Thanks all. Keep thread open for RMA completion and postmortem notes. For postmortem, focus on root cause (fan failure?) and whether thermal thresholds or auto-evict heuristics need tuning. Closing active mitigation updates here.
